newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Analysts say lower tax rate boost NAB.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Analysts say lower tax rate boost NAB.

text.p: Australian banking analysts said on Thursday National Australia Bank Ltd's record profit in 1995/96 (Oct-Sept) was largely helped by a lower tax rate.

"It came in a bit higher than we expected, but that was primarily due to a lower tax rate which related to the overprovisioning of taxes in previous years," said Michael Pulman, a banking analyst at brokers ABN Amro.
"It's a one-off thing. It doesn't really add to the quality of the earnings," Pulman told Reuters. NAB reported a 6.8 percent rise in net profit to A$2.1 billion in 1995/96.
